description: This file defines a React functional component called Starfield that renders a dynamic, animated starfield using HTML5 Canvas. It manages animation state with React refs, handles resize events, and draws multiple layers of stars with different densities, sizes, opacities, and velocities to create a parallax effect.

methods.name: buildStars
methods.description: Initializes star layers based on current canvas size and density, creating star objects with random positions, sizes, opacities, and velocities.

methods.name: makeLayer
methods.description: Creates an array of star objects for a specific layer, each with randomized properties within specified parameters.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Clears the canvas and draws all star layers with their current positions, applying parallax movement based on speed and delta time.

methods.name: drawLayer
methods.description: Draws individual star objects for a specific layer, updating their positions and wrapping them when they pass the bottom of the viewport.

methods.name: hexToRgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB object.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Generates a random number between two bounds.
